# Dear Wander

> Not a lock. A letter.

Dear Wander is an iOS app for mindful screen time. It intercepts social media app launches with a 60-120 second guided mindfulness experience (box breathing, guided imagery) before granting a 10-minute timed pass. It does not hard-block — it earns you access through presence.

## Key Facts

- Platform: iOS 17+
- Category: Screen Time / Digital Wellness / Mindfulness
- Approach: Mindful friction (guided breathing before app access), not hard blocking
- Technology: Native Apple FamilyControls + DeviceActivity API (no VPN, no Shortcuts)
- Privacy: All data stays on device. No accounts required. No tracking.
- Status: Live on the App Store since August 2026 (current version 1.0.2)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759883721
- Price: Free to start with one app; premium unlocks unlimited apps and the
  full guided library (subscription or one-time lifetime purchase)
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Availability: Not currently distributed in the European Union
- Website: https://dearwander.com
- Contact: hello@dearwander.com (or Instagram @dearwander.app)

## How It Works

1. **The Pause** — When you open a social media app, a warm breathing screen appears. 60 seconds of guided presence.
2. **The Wander** — After breathing, you earn 10 minutes of access. A gentle amber arc tracks the time.
3. **Come Home** — A soft reminder when your time is ending. Not an alarm. A letter.

## The Daily Loop

In the morning you write one intention. In the evening the app hands it back and
asks a single question built from what actually happened that day — the sentence
you wrote, the pauses you took, the minutes that didn't go into the phone. It is
never a blank page, which is the usual reason journalling apps get abandoned in a
week. Answers stay on the device and can be re-read in the Journey view.

## What Makes Dear Wander Different

- **Beauty as the product**: The intervention screen uses a "Golden Hour" glassmorphism aesthetic — warm amber gradients, frosted glass, guided imagery. It's designed to be something you look forward to, not something you endure.
- **Epistolary brand voice**: The app writes gentle letters to your wandering mind. "Dear Wander, let's stay here a moment."
- **Native iOS implementation**: Built on Apple's FamilyControls API. No VPN (unlike Opal), no Shortcuts dependency (unlike one sec). Blocks at the OS process level.
- **Non-punitive**: No shame metrics, no "you failed" messages. Only warmth, presence, and correspondence.
- **Two ritual modes**: First Light (morning) and Last Light (evening) — different breathing paces and visual temperatures for dawn and dusk.

## Competitors

Dear Wander competes with: one sec, Opal, ScreenZen, Jomo, Clearspace, Freedom, Pauso, Roots.
